newsitem.title: ITALY: Mediaset '96 net profit seen steady - papers.
newsitem.headline: Mediaset '96 net profit seen steady - papers.

text.p: Italian broadcaster Mediaset is expected to report a consolidated net profit of 445-450 billion lire when it announces 1996 results on Thursday, a fraction lower than 454.6 billion in 1995, two Italian newspapers said.
Italian financial dailies Il Sole 24 Ore and Milano Finanza both reported the group's board was considering raising the dividend for 1996, which in 1995 was 175 lire per share.
MF said in addition that parent profits at Mediaset, which is controlled by former prime minister Silvio Berlusconi's Fininvest group, were 371 billion, up 128 billion on 1995.
Mediaset's board meets on Thursday to approve the 1996 results and to decide on the size of the dividend.

Il Sole reported that in 1994 and 1995 Mediaset benefited from tax breaks under the Tremonti law, paying respectively 21.4 percent and 40.6 percent in taxes. The tax benefits were no longer available in 1996.
Total consolidated turnover reached 3.1 to 3.2 trillion lire in 1996 from 2.925 trillion in 1995, the newspaper said.
